newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Freight Index falls to nine year low.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Freight Index falls to nine year low.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index fell four points to 997 on Monday, breaking under 1,000 for the first first time since Aug 4, 1987.

The market was very quiet and continued its long term downtrend based on ample vessels to meet the shipping requirements of major bulk commodity industries such as grains, coal and ore, brokers said. There were very few optimists around in any section of the dry cargo market, they added.
The continued decline of the Index, a barometer of the world's major bulk shipping trades compiled by London's Baltic Exchange, has seen it fall from a historic high of 2,352 in May 1995.
Its all time low of 553.5 was reached on July 31, 1986.
